title: Inference for sparsely sampled Gauss-Markov processes under outcome-dependent dropout
summary: We consider sparsely observed functional data generated by a latent Gauss-Markov process modeled through a linear stochastic differential equation (SDE). Motivated by an application to tumor growth data, we allow for outcome-dependent dropout, where sampling terminates once the most recent observation exceeds a prescribed threshold. Such observation schemes arise naturally in longitudinal studies and violate the fundamental missing completely at random assumption commonly imposed in the analysis of partially observed functional data.
